title: Dwellings with no registered resident in Austria

current_state.value: 653,000 dwellings (13.3% of 4,909,410) had no person registered on 31 Oct 2021; a further 4.9% had only secondary residences, so 18.2% of the stock has no primary resident (1971: 8.8%). Kärnten 16.3%, Tirol 16.1%, Vienna 9.7%. The source itself warns that not all of these are vacant; Austria has no official vacancy statistic.

target.value: No official target. Proposed by the Commons: an official vacancy statistic by the next census, and the share of dwellings without any registration back under 10%.

context: One in seven Austrian dwellings has nobody registered in it while the country keeps building. The census cannot say how many are truly empty, which is itself the problem: nobody measures vacancy.
